item.title: Super Slabs
item.description: Hello everyone, I am a student and designed this extreme-contrast slab serif font in a 10 week typeface design course. The basis of my inspiration was on a single letter I found. I was hoping to get your thoughts on this, minor or major, so that I can continue building this to be better. Thanks!
